taxonomyNote: NatureServe primary name is Erckel's Francolin; formerly placed in Francolinus (AOU 1983, 1998), transferred to Pternistis by AOS (2019). ADW and DLNR still use Francolinus / Erckel's Francolin.
fieldMarks: About 16 in (40 cm), brown with white streaky spots
Chestnut feathers on top of the head and a white throat
behavior: Scares easily and hides, preferring to run rather than flush
Loud laughing cackle, especially in the morning
range: Native to Ethiopia and Sudan; introduced to Hawaii in 1957. NatureServe records it in Hawaii.
